issue.title: Flag Action should be called when value is set by alternative sources.
issue.body:
## Checklist

* [x] Are you running the latest v3 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).
`v3.0.0-beta1`
* [x] Did you check the manual for your release? The v3 manual is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/main/docs/v3/index.md).
* [x] Did you perform a search about this feature? Here's the [GitHub guide](https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/using-search-to-filter-issues-and-pull-requests) about searching.

## What problem does this solve?
Fix action beeing called for all circumstances when a value is set by either a flag or alternative source. Currently the flag action is only executed when given as argument. 

example: 
```
		Flags: []cli.Flag{
			&cli.StringFlag{
				Name:    flag_log_level,
				Usage:   "The log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic)",
				Value:   "info",
				Sources: cli.EnvVars(flagEnv(flag_log_level)),
				Action: func(ctx context.Context, cmd *cli.Command, value string) error {
					log.Info("Setting log level to ", value)
					level, err := log.ParseLevel(value)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					log.SetLevel(level)
					return nil
				},
			},
```
## Solution description

When a env var is set, the action should be called. 

## Describe alternatives you've considered
not using in this case as it is has no consistent experience for users.
